event: Commission proposes targeted ETS revision COM(2026) 616 (file 2026/0212(COD)): CBAM-sector free-allocation phase-out stretched from 2034 to 2038 (15% of the free allocation removed by the CBAM factor reintroduced from 2028); free allocation for other leakage sectors to 2040; conditionality from 2031; LRF 3.7% (2031-35) and 1.7% (2036-40)
is_new_since_2026_10_11: no (but missing from the 11 Oct workbook)
slides_affected: S4 (2034 end point), S13 KEEP bullet 1, S3, S11 footer, A3

event: Companion proposal COM(2026) 619 (file 2026/0211(COD)): heat and fuel benchmarks 2026-2030, about EUR 6 bn extra free allocation (EPRS estimate)
Council Working Party on the Environment meeting on the ETS review (Presidency steering note WK 13227/2026 dated 31 Aug 2026; shows the CBAM-factor table); not necessarily the first meeting
European Parliament plenary adopts amendments 464-50-159 and refers file back to committee for negotiations
Parliament announces committee referral of 2026/0212(COD) and 2026/0211(COD) to ENVI; indicative first-reading plenary 14 Dec 2026 (OEIL forecast)
Council Presidency background paper 13435/26 for Environment Council; Irish Presidency aims for a general approach at the December Environment Council
Commission publishes de minimis threshold assessment: 50 t threshold would exempt 0.87% of embedded emissions (1 Apr 2025 - 31 Mar 2026), below the 1% limit
Commission publishes updated factsheet 'How do CBAM certificates work' and webinar follow-up stating first compliance deadline 30 Sep 2027
Melt-and-pour evidence requirement (Article 4(1) of Regulation (EU) 2026/1384) starts to apply
Commission publishes Q3 2026 CBAM certificate price EUR 82.32
Environment Council policy debate on the ETS review proposals; no vote and no decision; Presidency to table a first compromise text afterwards
